canonical_name: Krull intersection theorem for a proper ideal of a commutative Noetherian local ring
literal_source_claim_zh: 诺特局部环中理想的交集性质
literal_source_claim_en: An ideal-intersection property in a Noetherian local ring.
canonical_statement: For every commutative Noetherian local ring R and every proper ideal I of R, the intersection of I^n over all natural numbers n is the zero ideal.
canonical_claim: Let R be a commutative Noetherian local ring and I a proper ideal of R. Then the intersection of all natural powers of I is the zero ideal.
statement_blocker: The catalog omits a source citation, formula, and definitions.
